run_update_hubert_checkpoint: run the script to load a HuBERT checkpoint, update its state, and save it
summarize_update_state: summarize the update_state function that renames label_embs to label_embs_concat and updates task args
review_update_state: review the update_state function for renaming model keys and modifying checkpoint arguments
